name: VersionDetail
title: Templates/Platform/Detail/VersionDetail
summary: One version of a resource, opened from its Versions tab: the platform shell whose last breadcrumb is a Select that switches between the resource versions, each with its state Tag, or creates a new one. Under it a horizontal `Resizable` holds the version workspace, a tab bar with Settings, Source, Variables, Cache Settings, Custom Code and Rules carrying the state Tag and a Version actions menu, the open tab in a fading `ScrollArea`, and the version bar pinned to the bottom that names the state and holds the Save and Deploy `SplitButton` on a draft or New Version and Redeploy on a built version, and a collapsible Version history pane with the current version, its changes and the earlier built versions. The stories open on the Settings tab; the Rules tab is the Forms/RuleBuilder template, and the Source, Variables, Cache Settings and Custom Code panels are not plotted here. Built from `PageHeader`, `PageTabs`, `SettingsSection`, `SettingRow`, the platform shell, `Breadcrumb`, `Select`, `Resizable`, `Tabs`, `Tag`, `DropdownMenu`, `ScrollArea`, `Card`, `Item`, `Input`, `Switch`, `Hint`, `SplitButton`, `Button`, `Avatar`, `Field` and `Textarea`.

variants.name: Deployed
variants.summary: The deployed version, read-only: the creation date beside the Deployed Tag, the settings fieldset disabled, and the version bar reading Viewing a Deployed version and Read Only with its description, New Version and Redeploy.

variants.name: VersionHistory
variants.summary: The draft with Version history open beside it: the current version with its description, author and the pencil that edits it in place, the empty changes entry, and the five newest earlier versions with Show older for the rest.
